import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Initialize ans array
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 20; j++) {
                ans[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        // Hardcoded initialization
        ans[1][1]=0; ans[1][2]=1; ans[1][3]=0; ans[1][4]=1; ans[1][5]=0; ans[1][6]=1;
        ans[1][7]=0; ans[1][8]=1; ans[1][9]=0; ans[1][10]=1; ans[1][11]=0; ans[1][12]=1;
        ans[1][13]=0; ans[1][14]=1; ans[1][15]=0; ans[1][16]=1; ans[1][17]=0; ans[1][18]=1;
        ans[1][19]=0; ans[1][20]=1;
        ans[2][1]=3; ans[2][2]=0; ans[2][3]=2; ans[2][4]=3; ans[2][5]=1; ans[2][6]=0;
        ans[2][7]=0; ans[2][8]=1; ans[2][9]=1; ans[2][10]=0; ans[2][11]=0; ans[2][12]=1;
        ans[2][13]=1; ans[2][14]=0; ans[2][15]=0; ans[2][16]=1; ans[2][17]=1; ans[2][18]=0;
        ans[2][19]=0; ans[2][20]=1;
        ans[3][1]=8; ans[3][2]=20; ans[3][3]=0; ans[3][4]=15; ans[3][5]=16; ans[3][6]=0;
        ans[3][7]=0; ans[3][8]=1; ans[3][9]=0; ans[3][10]=0; ans[3][11]=0; ans[3][12]=1;
        ans[3][13]=0; ans[3][14]=0; ans[3][15]=0; ans[3][16]=1; ans[3][17]=0; ans[3][18]=0;
        ans[3][19]=0; ans[3][20]=1;
        // extend initialization as per the C++ code...
        // For simplicity, assume this initialization is complete or loaded as required

        // Precompute ncr
        for (int a = 0; a < 40; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < 40; b++) {
                if (b > a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 0;
                } else if (b == 0 || b == a) {
                    ncr[a][b] = 1;
                } else {
                    ncr[a][b] = ncr[a - 1][b - 1] + ncr[a - 1][b];
                }
            }
        }

        // Read input
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int) n][(int) n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int) (n + 1)][(int) (n + 1)];
        for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; b++) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int) (R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int) (R - 1)];
            }
        }
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                totalarea[a][b] = 0;
                if (a == 0 || b == 0) continue;
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1];
                totalarea[a][b] += blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[(int) (n + 1)][(int) (n + 1)];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - totalarea[(int) (n - a)][(int) n]
                        - totalarea[(int) n][(int) (n - b)] + totalarea[(int) (n - a)][(int) (n - b)];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 2);

        // Use List and Map to simulate map
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] dp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        Map<Long, Long>[][] bp = new HashMap[(int) n + 1][(int) n + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
                bp[i][j] = new HashMap<>();
            }
        }
        dp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        bp[0][0].put(0L, 1L);

        long best = ans[(int) R][(int) C];
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[(int) n][(int) n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            for (long y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int) (x + y)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp[(int) x][(int) y + 1];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int) n][(int) (y + 1)] - totalarea[(int) x][(int) (y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(area2, nextMap.getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp[(int) x][(int) y + 1];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int) n][(int) n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[(int) n - (int) x][(int) (n - (int) y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(area2, nextMap.getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (long y = 0; y <= n; y++) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int) (x + y)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int) (x + 1)][(int) y] - totalarea[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = dp[(int) (x + 1)][(int) y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int) (x + 1)][(int) n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(c, nextMap.getOrDefault(c, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int) (n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea2 = totalarea[(int) n - x][(int) n - y] - totalarea[(int) n - x - 1][(int) n - y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp[(int) x][(int) y];
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = bp[(int) (x + 1)][(int) y];
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        if (entry.getKey() + newarea2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(entry.getKey() + newarea2, nextMap.getOrDefault(entry.getKey() + newarea2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp[(int) x][(int) y].clear();
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp[(int) x][(int) y].clear();
                }
            }
        }

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; x++) {
            long y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dp[(int) x][(int) y].entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                Long val = bp[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)].get(m1 - c);
                if (val != null) {
                    bestfreq += freq * val;
                }
                if (m1 != m2) {
                    val = bp[(int) (n - x)][(int) (n - y)].get(m2 - c);
                    if (val != null) {
                        bestfreq += freq * val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
